Chapter 728: Chapter 22: Crushing Tier 11 (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 728: Chapter 22: Crushing Tier 11 (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

But by then, it was already too late.

Until the very end, the life from the Ice Clan had never bowed their head.

This being from the Ice Clan understood that the only hope for escaping from this Two-dimensional World lay in the exotic treasure they held in their hand.

Now that the Tuoba Ancient God had taken the treasure, even if they promised to spare their life, there was no way they could leave successfully.

Rather than that, it was better to detonate themselves and leave the stage.

“These weaklings boast about their good luck and chance discovery of ‘exotic treasures’, little do they know that these ‘exotic treasures’ can only exhibit their true power in our hands.”

...

The Tuoba Ancient God spoke, his gaze frosty, “In the coming time, let us comb through the Xueyu Ancient Country thoroughly, if we can obtain any additional ‘exotic treasures’, you will also have a share.”

“Good.”

The other unique beings exchanged glances and nodded in agreement.

Exotic treasures are naturally reclusive, even if they are within their perception range, they could not be detected.

So—

Directly searching for exotic treasures is very difficult because you fundamentally don’t know what they look like.

But for over a hundred years, as information about the ‘exotic treasures’ spread among the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, many of them searched for these treasures.

The Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses spread throughout the Two-dimensional World, widely searching for ‘exotic treasures’ was as difficult as ascending to the heavens, but searching for Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses was not.

Most powerhouses couldn’t catch the eye of Tuoba Ancient God and other special beings, but it must be admitted that even the weakest from the Main Universe possessed good insight.

If they were lucky, even a Tier 8 life has the hope of obtaining an exotic treasure.

This was also why the Tuoba Ancient God and other special beings hunted the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses — first, to clear the field, and second, for the ‘exotic treasures’.

As to whether they would encounter an iron wall by meeting stronger Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses than themselves?

The probability was very very small.

With the Tuoba Ancient God and other special beings joining forces, the only Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses that could threaten them were the top nine ranks among them.

But these nine strong beings were heavily watched by many other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

They only needed to avoid those few areas, and they could be described as completely safe.

“Calculating the time, in at most two years, we would have searched through most of the Xueyu Ancient Country…” Pei Shen, who was carrying a pitch-black iron staff, was about to continue speaking when,

suddenly,

his complexion slightly changed.

He abruptly looked in one direction.

Ten miles away, a terrifying aura suddenly erupted.

Boom! Boom! Boom!!

The owner of this aura seemed to rip through the air, approaching at nearly ten times the speed of sound, causing a rolling thunderous boom in its wake.

“Did a powerhouse discover us prematurely?”

Pei Shen’s expression turned solemn as the owner of the aura headed straight for their location, the only possibility being that they knew of their presence here.

Discovering them beforehand meant that the opponent’s perceptual range was broader than theirs.

The perceptual range generally correlates with one’s strength and Realm.

Of course, Pei Shen wasn’t worried. They were six in total, and both he and Tuoba possessed ‘exotic treasures’.

Even if they really encountered Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses stronger than them, as long as it wasn’t at the level of the top nine powerhouses, they feared nothing.

The distance of ten miles was very short,

especially at nearly ten times the speed of sound.

In just the span of a breath, that figure had already arrived in front of Tuoba Ancient God and the group.

Tuoba Ancient God and the other five special beings did not scatter to escape.

Doing so would have given this Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouse the chance to defeat them one by one.

Hum.

Lin Yuan stopped, looking warily at the six special beings scrutinizing him.

When the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses fell into the Two-dimensional World, not only were all their powers downgraded, but even their body shapes and sizes conformed to the appearance of mainstream humans in this world.

Boom.

Lin Yuan didn’t waste words, he directly made a move, sweeping down with a palm strike.

The air subtly became viscous. Lin Yuan did not attack the strongest, Tuoba Ancient God and Pei Shen, but aimed at the other four slightly weaker special beings instead.

It wasn’t that he feared Tuoba Ancient God and Pei Shen; rather, he planned to leave all six behind.

First to take out the weaker ones, preventing them from scattering and escaping later.

“Not good.”

The four special beings only felt their scalps tingle. Under Lin Yuan’s palm strike, although no extraordinary phenomena appeared and no cosmic rules were manipulated, in their eyes, it was as if the heavens were falling.

Although these four special beings were of the Tenth Realm and the Eleventh Realm, being Tier 11 lifeforms in the outside world, they still had the most basic awareness.

The moment Lin Yuan attacked them, they realized that facing him head-on meant certain death.

“Retreat.”

The four special beings hesitated not a moment and scattered in all directions, but Lin Yuan’s palm strike was far faster than their retreat.

Shraa.

The special being on the far left was directly hit by the palm.

“Bang!” This special being felt as if all his internal organs had been shattered. His body, refined over a hundred years or more, under that palm strike, was as fragile as thin paper, easily torn apart.

Lin Yuan’s palm strike penetrated one special being and did not stop, continuing at undiminished speed toward the second and third special beings.

“Take action.”

Pei Shen next to him decisively rushed out, wielding the pitch-black iron staff, aiming it at Lin Yuan.

The pitch-black iron staff faintly radiated black light. In this Two-dimensional World, only these inherently Twelve-Star Strange Treasures’ weapons could somewhat break free from the world’s oppressive downgrading.

Boom!

The next moment,

the iron staff vibrated continuously, nearly flying out of Pei Shen’s grasp.

“You?”

Pei Shen looked at Lin Yuan in shock. Under his full-force strike, Lin Yuan had not even stepped back, only slightly hindered in his assault.
